title: an update in case anyone is wondering how this project went
author: Square-Yam-3772
selftext:
context: I spent 3-4 weeks on this project (would have taken longer but I had some free resets). initially I had bigger plans for it but it lost momentum after a while. the early gameplay footages also don't seem to attract much attention so I just put in some minimum polish and call it a wrap. 

I am happy to answer any questions.

replies.author: Shitty_Soliloquy
replies.body: I thought I recognized Atlas Park.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
it is a smaller scale project with a similar "spirit" I suppose.

when I was cooking up the character customization, that def crossed my mind.

we will see I guess. I kinda just want to park this and see where this leads first.

comments.author: TerribleFault7929
comments.body: ask AI to explain you what it means to compress a video first

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: the pixelate effect is intentional (not particularly done well but it was intentional)

replies.author: TerribleFault7929
replies.body: again, you need to \_COMPRESS A VIDEO\_ so it would load smoothly on the client's side

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: umm, I am pretty sure the platforms already compress it... why would I end up with a uncompressed mp4? or why would a platform like reddit feed you the uncompressed version of the video? that can't be good for bandwidth....

replies.author: TerribleFault7929
replies.body: Okay, kid—file this one away for ten years. And when grown-up you finally gets it: fuck you too.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: I asked AI exactly as you suggested and you somehow seem angry about it. shrug.

replies.body: Who hurt you? Like for real why are you so angry at someone just sharing a video.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
oh wow. yeah, we have similar idea then. 

solving the destruction problem with cube-like buildings is pretty clever actually. 

your combat system is way more complex than mine too

I am surprised you can squeeze all that into a browser app. 

I left a comment and gave you a follow. keep it up

comments.author: Grrowling
comments.body: Delete the project and redo it with Opus 5.5

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
I am actually just going to work on a new project. if the project is doing well, I may add more content or fix some bugs. 

I don't own the idea so feel free to make one with Opus 5.5 if you feel like it. 

this idea came from another indie game from a few years back anyway; undefeated (I think)... that game is more prototype + dbz + superman while mine is temu superman

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
oh... I didn't add them. I can add them for the next update I guess. 

another person mentioned superman 64 so yeah... I may as well lean harder into that

comments.author: OwoMeji
comments.body: Honestly you should be proud of what you have done so far. If Superman 64 had been able to do these things, it may not have been as bad as it was.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
I am pretty happy with the experience. this project idea is on my mind some time ago but It wasn't very doable at the time i.e. researching into mesh destruction and integration it into a project alone would take me weeks back then if I sink all my free time into it even...

AI also helped out with the optimization effort so that was nice. fps dropped in 10-15 at some point so the project would have been dead without an optimization fix.
